title: Shopping list generation
lead: Build list items from the confirmed plan, aggregating quantities (L2).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** pantry subtraction (Phase 2); runout or "low" staples (S39); one-tap staples (S25); UI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Turning a plan into a list automatically is most of the value of the MVP. Staples are added by hand with one tap (L3, S25) and are only kept here when the list is regenerated.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
None if the list interview is done. ADR 0020 must say how a range and an alternatives line become a list quantity and text; if it does not, ask the owner before implementing tests 7 and 8.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, ADR 0019 (S15): sum the same item across recipes within one unit dimension, never across volume and weight; cans count as cans; basics (salt, pepper, oil) never appear automatically unless a staple that is low; category order per ADR 0019. The range and alternatives question still waits for the shopping-list interview (S23).

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, ADR 0020 (S23) answers the range and alternatives question: a range puts its high end (qty_max) on the list; an alternatives line lists its first choice only. Quantities shown are the recipe quantities, summed within a unit dimension, with the source recipes kept on each line; free-text items are allowed and sort after the categorized items.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/shopping/generate.py`
- `src/larder/shopping_db.py` (SQL: plan ingredient lines with `qty_max` and alternatives; list item writes)
- `tests/test_list_generate.py`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Collect ingredient lines from the confirmed plan; skip optional and non-food ones per ADR 0020.
2. Group by item; convert and sum within a dimension (ADR 0019). A range uses the bound ADR 0020 names; alternatives follow ADR 0020 (S59 columns).
3. Merge with existing list items: generated items are tagged `source=plan` and replaced on regenerate; manual and staple items are kept.
4. Subscribe to the `plan_confirmed` / plan-edit hooks.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Generation tests pass; the list for a real week matches what the owner would have written by hand.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
